messages:
deploy-bot: Canary ramp scheduled: rollout id r-2026-03-21-12 -> 5% -> 25% across regions starting now. Metrics watcher attached: https://telemetry.redwood/r/r-2026-03-21-12 :rocket:

tina: seeing eu-west tail latency tick up ~220ms at the 5% mark, not sure if transient. tagging ops-oncall. Can we pause the ramp and hold at 5% while we validate? :thinking_face:

sam: +1 pause. I can pull logs and run a quick compare vs previous release. pulling top traces now (will post snippets).

meera: If we hold, recommend pinning traffic in eu-west to previous version to avoid customer impact while we triage. We should also surface release notes link for QA: https://git.redwood/release-notes/r-2026-03-21

raj: What do we know about model/infra delta? Was the canary using a new quantization profile or kernel change? If it's infra, pinning traffic helps but we may still see residuals.

sam: quick check: canary used q4f-v2 quant profile + kernel opt switch. CPU tail on the inference host is slightly higher. Attaching two lines from logs:
```
2026-03-21T12:03:10Z inferer-3 eu-west cpu=72% seq=512 latency_p95=180ms
2026-03-21T12:03:14Z inferer-3 eu-west cpu=88% seq=512 latency_p95=420ms
```

luis: ops-oncall, I can push a regional pin to route eu-west 100% to r-2026-03-20-09 while team digs in. That will keep global gradual ramp for others.

ops-oncall: Decision needed: pause global ramp? or hold global but pin eu-west? My recommendation: hold ramp (no increase beyond 5%), pin eu-west back to previous stable, and open a hotfix branch to test q4f-v2 on a separate infra slice. Vote with :thumbsup: to proceed.

tina: I vote :thumbsup: to hold + pin. We want minimal customer risk.

meera: :thumbsup: agree. I'll start a quick smoke test run for q4f-v2 on dedicated infra and add to the rollout checklist.

raj: :thumbsup: if pinning is quick. If hotfix needed, we'll prepare rollback playbook.

sam: executing pin command now:
`rbctl traffic pin --region eu-west --to r-2026-03-20-09 --reason "latency spike on canary q4f-v2"`
deploy-bot: Action taken: traffic pinned for region eu-west -> r-2026-03-20-09 by sam at 2026-03-21T12:11:03Z. Global ramp paused at 5%.

luis: Confirmed routing change propagated to edge, caches warmed. Monitoring shows eu-west tail back to baseline in the last 30s.

ops-oncall: OK consensus: hold and pin. Tasks: 1) meera to run infra-smoke on q4f-v2 slice, 2) sam to correlate kernel opt metrics, 3) raj to prepare rollback docs if we need to revert global. We'll reconvene in 20m or earlier if new signals.

tina: adding postmortem owner and timeline to the thread: owner meera, initial triage in 2h, postmortem within 48h. Also updating change window notes to indicate the pause.

meera: got it — starting smoke now, will report back in ~8-10m.

sam: posted trace diff and perf dash: https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/rollout/r-2026-03-21-12/diff

ops-oncall: Thanks all. If anyone sees error rate climb or customer escalations, call it out immediately and we'll trigger a full rollback. For now, hold and pin. :white_check_mark:
